description: Ask for a correction to a record: say what is wrong, with sources. Sent as a correction. Needs an API key, free from https://qed.bot/check, sent as Authorization: Bearer qed_.... It goes to review: nothing in the register changes until it is reviewed in public, and grades are never bought. Once the register carries it, the account behind the key is credited with points (see leaderboard). Returns the submission's id; poll get_submission with it.

claim_id.description: Optional: the claim on that record the correction concerns

node.description: The statement or target id the correction is about

sources.description: One to five http(s) links that show it: the paper, the repository at its commit, the announcement

what.description: What is wrong and what the sources show, 20 to 5000 characters

name: flag_record
